description: This Java source file defines the UpdateService class, which is a WearableListenerService that handles data layer updates for a speed tracker application. It manages incoming location data events, updates internal data storage, and deletes processed data items.

classes.name: UpdateService
classes.description: A WearableListenerService that processes data layer events related to location updates, manages GoogleApiClient connection, and deletes data items after processing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and the data manager when the service is created.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming data events, processes location data, updates internal data storage, and schedules data item deletion.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the GoogleApiClient connects, particularly deleting pending data items.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Placeholder for handling suspension of the GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs an error if the GoogleApiClient fails to connect.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of data item deletion attempts, logging errors if deletion failed.
